About Blaize Fitness

Built from the inside out.

Ryan's story didn't start in a gym. It started with him looking in the mirror and not liking what he saw. He was carrying an extra 100 pounds and felt stuck, out of energy, and unsure where to even begin. Fitness became his way out, and four years later that same journey is the reason Blaize Fitness exists.

He remembers exactly what it feels like to walk into a gym for the first time and feel completely out of place. That memory shapes everything he does now. Every session, every plan, every conversation is built around one simple goal: making sure you feel safe, supported, and capable from day one.

Whether you train in person or online, Ryan meets you where you are right now. No judgment, no pressure to be someone you're not yet. Just steady progress, real encouragement, and a coach who has actually lived the transformation he's helping you find.
